mockAnswer.userQuestion: What are the best coffee shops in Almaty?
mockAnswer.intro: Choosing a coffee shop depends on what you value most: beans, atmosphere or speed. Here's a breakdown of the popular options:
mockAnswer.blurb1: A large chain with consistent quality and locations all over the city. Convenient when you want predictability: the menu and taste are the same everywhere. Expect queues at peak hours.
mockAnswer.blurb2: Known for breakfasts and desserts, with cozy rooms for long meetings. The coffee is reliably good and the staff attentive. Prices are above the city average.
mockAnswer.blurb3: Operating since 2012: a wide menu, fast service and in-house roasting. A solid choice for everyday coffee. Weekends can get crowded.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: How is the Visibility Score calculated?
faq.a1: The main score measures how often and how prominently your business appears in successful unbranded AI answers. Branded recognition is measured separately, so asking directly about your business does not inflate the main score.
faq.q2: Which AI systems do you check?
faq.a2: The free audit currently evaluates model families associated with ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. The results are a measured sample and may differ from answers shown in individual consumer applications.
faq.q3: How long does the audit take?
faq.a3: A free audit usually completes within a few minutes. Timing can vary depending on provider availability, and we email you the report link when it is ready.
faq.a4: AI answers can change with the model, time, wording and retrieved sources. Your audit is a dated sample that shows the current situation, not a guaranteed or permanent ranking.
faq.a5: We review your report, identify why competitors appear instead of you, and propose an improvement plan covering content, business information, sources and external mentions. If we agree on the scope, our team carries out the work.
faq.a6: The AI visibility audit is free. Improvement work is priced separately after the call because the required scope depends on your industry, current online presence and competition.
